summary: Clallam County, WA 45-foot steel tower built in 1942 near Neah Bay and gone by 1945; no source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1945 according to the register; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Register and firelookout.com both date the 45-foot steel tower to 1942
Register says gone by 1945; firelookout.com says gone in 1945
Registered November 26, 2011 as US 1151, WA 59; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.quote: Built in 1942, this 45' steel tower was gone by 1945.

evidence.supports: administered by Washington State Division of Forestry/DNR
about a mile northeast of Neah Bay
index lists the site as AWS Baada Point
evidence.quote: AWS Baada Point Clallam 48.37324 -124.59056 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1151, WA 59

notes_for_editor: Both sources give the same 1942 build, 45-foot height and 1945 removal, with no independent third source found. No source describes the site today or its public access, so no access level is recorded. Reason for removal is not stated. The 'AWS' name is not explained by any source read; a willhiteweb.com page about a different nearby lookout (Neah) was not used. The record has no built year; 1942 comes from the register and firelookout.com. Record coordinates and elevation match the register.
